confidence_notes: Recent Palermo Numbeo and Expatistan prices (October 2026) proxy July food and drink levels; Expatistan's sample is sparse. Cocktail uses its reported price; wine is estimated at about 0.9 times local draft beer. July accommodation prices are model estimates and less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used: food and drink are based on Palermo price data, and accommodation on a general Sicily summer tourism estimate.
